description: This file defines an abstract base class 'SqlBase' for SQL-based pagers in Drupal's Views module, including configuration options, form building, query modification, and cache handling.

classes.name: SqlBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for SQL-based pagers in Drupal Views, including configuration, form handling, query modification, and cache management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pager manager and parameters.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the pager, including items per page, offset, total pages, and expose settings.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the pager, allowing customization of options via UI.

methods.name: validateOptionsForm
methods.description: Validates the options form input, ensuring numeric and logical correctness.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Modifies the view's query to apply limit and offset based on current pager settings.

methods.name: setCurrentPage
methods.description: Sets the current page, either from a provided number or via pager parameters.

methods.name: getPagerTotal
methods.description: Calculates total number of pages based on total items and items per page.

methods.name: updatePageInfo
methods.description: Updates total items and current page info after counting query.

methods.name: usesExposed
methods.description: Indicates if the pager uses exposed filters for items per page or offset.

methods.name: itemsPerPageExposed
methods.description: Checks if items per page is exposed.

methods.name: exposedFormAlter
methods.description: Alters the exposed form to include controls for items per page and offset.

methods.name: exposedFormValidate
methods.description: Validates the exposed form inputs for offset.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age as permanent.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts related to URL query arguments.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags, empty in this implementation.
